title: Keto Russian Dumplings
description: Tender, cheesy dumplings wrapped in a crispy, low-carb dough. A unique twist on traditional Russian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Low-carb dumpling dough
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a low-carb flour blend to keep the dough keto-friendly

ingredients.name: Russian cheese blend
ingredients.notes: Mix cheddar and parmesan cheese for a gooey, savory filling

ingredients.name: Keto-friendly egg
ingredients.notes: Use a keto-friendly egg substitute if necessary

ingredients.name: Sour cream
ingredients.notes: Add a tangy flavor to the filling

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh dill
ingredients.notes: Add a burst of fresh flavor to the filling

ingredients.name: Ghee or coconut oil
ingredients.notes: Use a keto-friendly oil for frying

ingredients.name: Optional: bar-b-q sauce
ingredients.notes: Add a sweet and tangy flavor to the dumplings

instructions: Make the low-carb dumpling dough according to the package instructions.
Mix the Russian cheese blend, keto-friendly egg, sour cream, chopped fresh dill, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the cheese mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape. Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Fry the dumplings in ghee or coconut oil until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
Serve the dumplings hot, with optional bar-b-q sauce on the side.
